name: sloppy-20
purpose: The 20 sloppy real-world texts for Phase 1 wiring. Each starts a fresh thread. The bar is spec 16: at least 95% (19 of 20) understood on the first message, meaning routed to the right flow and answered with a confirmation card that carries the right amount and the right name, with no clarifying question, in two SMS segments at most, and nothing executed.
runs_against: the LIVE agent-chat handler only (evals/gauntlet/run-live.cjs); never the domain modules
preconditions: A test user whose linked feed has a monthly NETFLIX.COM charge of $17.99 and whose cancel terms read from the Netflix sandbox account page.
A saved recipient Sam (one Sam only) reachable on Venmo and Zelle, with prior payment history.
A linked Schwab brokerage account and a linked Roth IRA, both with settled cash of at least $1,500, and live quotes for VOO and VT, during market hours or with queuing allowed.
A broker-dealer partner and money-movement partner configured in sandbox mode so the compliance gate opens; no real money moves because every text is answered with "no" right after the card.

items.text: put 500 in the vanguard s&p fund
buy five hundred dollars of VOO
can u cancel netflix for me
get rid of that netflix thing
send $40 to sam for the uber
can you zelle sam forty dollars
